senses.gloss: नियत नि-यत. See col. 3.

नि-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, checked, curbed, restrained,
held in; governed, controlled, subdued, submissive,
self-governed; abstemious, self-denying, temperate;
attentive, intent upon; fixed, constant, steady, per-
manent, incessant; ascertained, certain, destined,
settled, sure; inevitable; positive, definite; perme-
able, what may be spread through or over?; (अम्),
n. elementary or crude matter, the recipient of attri-
butes or properties; (अम्), ind. always, constantly,
decidedly, positively, surely, certainly, inevitably; for-
cibly.
—नियत-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, of subdued
mind or spirit.
—नियत-विषय-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
steadily abiding in one's own sphere.
—नियतात्मन्
(˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, self-regulated, self-controlled, self-
restrained.
—नियताहार (˚त-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
abstemious in food, temperate.
—नियतेन्द्रिय (˚त-
इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having the passions subdued or
restrained.

नियन्त्र् नि-यन्त्र्, cl. 10. P. -यन्त्रयति, &c.,
to restrain, [apparently only used in the derivatives.]

नि-यन्त्रण, अम्, n. the act of restraining, restraint,
checking; governing, guiding; defining, definition.

नि-यन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, restrained, curbed, checked;
governed, guided.

नियम् नि-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्,
to check, curb, restrain, hold back, suppress, stop;
to hold in (as the breath &c.); govern, control, rule,
direct, regulate; to punish; to restrict; to bind,
confine, fasten; to conceal; to attain, obtain; to
assume; to present, offer; to place or fix upon:
Caus. -यमयति, -यितुम्, to restrain, curb, check.

नि-यति, इस्, f. restraint, restriction; the fixed
order of things, necessity, destiny, fate, luck, good or
bad fortune; a religious duty or obligation; self-
command, self-restraint; (नियति is sometimes per-
sonified as a goddess, she and Āyati being regarded
as daughters of Meru and wives of Dhātṛ and Vi-
dhātṛ); (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā.

नि-यन्तवय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be restrained, checked,
controlled, tamed; to be forced.
नि-यन्तु in दुर्-न्˚, q. v.

नि-यन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what holds in,
restrains, curbs, governs, guides, tames, &c.; re-
straining; (ता), m. a restrainer, charioteer, driver,
coachman; a ruler, governor, master; a punisher.
—नियन्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. restraint, government, abi-
lity to rule, power of restraining, controlling faculty.

नि-यम, अस्, m. restraining, holding back, check-
ing, keeping back; taming, subduing, preventing,
confining; restraint, restriction, restriction to (with
loc.); limitation; fixing, defining, definition; keeping
down, lowering (as the tone of the voice); fixed
rule or law, necessity, obligation; rule, precept (e. g.
स्त्रीणाम् प्राकृत-भाषणम् एव नियमः, the
usage of women is to speak only Prākṛt); certainty,
ascertainment; agreement, contract, engagement,
assent, promise, vow; any self-imposed restraint or
religious observance voluntarily practised, as fast-
ing, watching, pilgrimage, praying, &c.; voluntary
penance, meritorious or supererogatory piety; a lesser
vow, minor observance (as opposed to यम, a greater
vow which must always be observed); (in rhetoric)
a common-place in poetry, any conventional expres-
sion or usual comparison (as notice of the birch in
describing the Himālaya, of the sandal tree in de-
scribing the Malaya mountains, of the peacock's cry
in the rains, of the koïl in spring, &c.); Necessity
or Fixed Law personified as a son of Dharma by
Dhṛti; (एन or आत्), ind. by a fixed rule, necessarily,
surely, certainly.
—नियम-निष्ठा, f. rigid ob-
servance of prescribed rites.
—नियम-पत्त्र, अम्,
n. a written agreement or stipulation.
—नियम-
पर, अस्, आ, अम्, observing fixed rules; relating to
or corroborative of a rule.
—नियम-पाल, अस्, m.
‘observer of vows,’ N. of a sage from whom the
Nepalese derive the name of their country, (properly
Nipāl.)
—नियम-भङ्ग, अस्, m. breach of a
stipulation or contract.
—नियम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
practising or observing religious observances; (अती), f.
(a woman) having the monthly courses.
—नियम-
स्थिति, इस्, f. a state of self-restraint, steady observance
of religious obligations, asceticism.

नि-याम, अस्, m. = नि-यम, restraint; religious
vow, penance, fasting, &c., especially if an act of
supererogation; = नि-यामक, a boatman, sailor; [cf.
निर्-याम.]

नि-यमन, अस्, ई, अम्, regulating, controlling,
subduing, taming, overpowering; (अम्), n. subduing,
checking, restraining; humiliation, coercion; binding;
restriction, limitation; precept, fixed practice or rule.

नि-यामन, अम्, n. taming, checking, restraining;
(probably incorrectly for नि-यमन.)

नीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being led or conducted or
conveyed, being carried or brought, being taken or
taken away; being traced or sought or obtained.
नीयमान नीयमान. See p. 511, col. 2.

नि-यमित, अस्, आ, अम्, checked, restrained, sup-
pressed, bound, confined; governed, guided; fixed,
regulated, prescribed, stipulated, agreed upon.

1. नि-यम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be checked or re-
strained, restrainable, tamable.

2. नि-यम्य, ind. having restrained, having
guided, &c.

नि-यामक, अस्, आ, अम्, restraining, checking, con-
trolling, subduing, suppressing, overpowering; re-
strictive, limiting; defining more closely; guiding,
governing, who or what regulates or restrains; a re-
strainer, ruler, master; (अस्), m. a charioteer; a boat-
man, a sailor, but variously applied to one who rows
or steers, a pilot, a helmsman; [cf. निर्-याम.]
—नि-
यामक-ता, f. controllership, power of restraining,
restraint; exact definition, explanation.

निययिन् नि-ययिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. या with
नि), Ved. driving over, passing over (as a carriage).
नि-यान, अम्, n., Ved. way, access.
नियव नि-यव. See under 2. नि-यु below.

नि-यव, अस्, m. compact order, continuous line or
series; (Sāy.) mixing, mixture.

नियातन नि-यातन, अम्, n. causing to fall
or descend; (wrong reading for नि-पातन, q. v.)

नियु 1. नि-यु, cl. 3. P. -युयोति, &c., Ved.
to repel, keep off.

नि-युत्, त्, f., Ved. series, line, row; (Sāy.) a
horse, steed (as harnessed to a car), especially one of
the horses of Vāyu called Niyuts; praise, a praiser;
(अस्), f. pl. series of words [cf. ग्रन्थ, नि-बन्-
धन], verses, a poem; (Sāy.) a team of horses,
especially the Niyuts or horses of Vāyu; N. of a
wife of Rudra in one of his different forms.
—नियुत्-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. forming a series; flowing
continuously, as the Soma; drawn by a line of horses,
as Vāyu or Indra, or the Maruts; (Sāy.) possessing
the Niyut steeds, possessing horses; containing the
word नियुत् or नियुत्-वत् (as a verse or hymn).
—नियुद्-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose car is
drawn by a line or team of horses; (Sāy.) having a
harnessed chariot.

नि-युत, अम्, n. (according to some lexicographers
also m.), a million; a hundred thousand; 100 Ayutas
= 10, 000 Koṭis.
नियुत नि-युत. See under 2. नि-यु, col. 1.

नि-युत्वतीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to
Niyut-vat (Vāyu).

नियुज् नि-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते,
-योक्तुम्, to join to, attach or fasten to; to put to
(horses), yoke, harness; to place over, appoint, elect
or depute any one to any office or duty (with acc.
of the person and loc. of the thing or business); to
give authority, authorize; to assign, employ, engage;
to commit, intrust, commission; to enjoin, order,
command; to constrain, urge, coerce, compel; to
harass: Caus. (or cl. 10.) -योजयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to be attached, cause to be placed or put, to fasten;
to appoint, commission, charge, employ; to order,
command, direct, prescribe; to urge, instigate, coerce;
to perform, make, place in any state (e. g. सन्देहे,
in jeopardy); to offer, present with, endow.

नि-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened to; engaged in,
attached to; directed, enjoined, commanded; autho-
rized, appointed; ascertained; (अस्), m. a functionary,
official.

नि-युक्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, appointed, elected, placed
in authority.

नि-युक्ति, इस्, f. injunction, order, command; ap-
pointment, commission, charge, office.

नि-युज्य, ind. having joined or attached; having
put to or harnessed; having appointed, &c.

नि-युज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being appointed,
being engaged or employed.

नि-युञ्जान, अस्, आ, अम्, appointing, authorizing,
enjoining, constituting, appointing to an office.

नि-योक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be appointed or autho-
rized, to be employed, ordered, &c.

नि-योक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who joins or fastens
or attaches; (ता), m. a ruler, lord master.

नि-योग, अस्, m. attaching or fastening to; appli-
cation, use, employment, appointment, injunction,
direction, order, command, commission, charge,
precept; any trust or appointed task or duty, any
business or function committed to one's charge;
effort, exertion; certainty, ascertainment; necessity;
(आत् or एन), ind. according to order or command,
necessarily, certainly, surely.
—नियोग-करण, अम्,
n. making a command, commanding.
—नियोग-तस्,
ind. according to order or command.
—नियोग-
पाश, अस्, m. a fastening, (probably) a halter.
—नि-
योग-प्रयोजन, अम्, n. the object or business of
any appointment, authorized act or duty.
—नियोग-
विधि, इस्, m. the form or rule of appointing to any
act or duty.
—नियोगार्थ (˚ग-अर्˚), अस्, m. the
object of an authorized act or appointment.
नियोग नि-योग. See under नि-युज् above.

नि-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, appointed, authorized, invested
with authority, employed, engaged in any duty,
attached to any business; (ई), m. a functionary, an
official, officer, man in office, a minister, a deputy,
an agent, &c.
—नियोग्य्-अर्थ-ग्रहोपाय (˚ह-
उप्˚), अस्, m. the resource of confiscating the property
of men in office.

नि-योग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be enjoined or prescribed;
fit to be appointed or authorized, able or qualified
for a duty [cf. नि-योज्य]; (अस्), m. (according to Vopa-
deva) a master.

नि-योजन, अम्, n. tying or fastening (as an
animal to the Yūpa or sacrificial post); uniting,
attaching to; that with which anything is fastened
or tied (Ved.); ordering, prescribing, commanding,
directing; urging, impelling; appointing (e. g. क्रि-
यासु, to affairs); (ई), f. a halter.

नि-योजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached or joined
to, to be appointed or authorized.

नि-योजयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), to be
appointed, to be commanded or urged or directed.

नि-योजित, अस्, आ, अम्, joined or attached to, con-
nected with, adapted to; appointed, authorized,
commissioned; directed, ordered; impelled, urged,
instigated.

नि-योज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fastened or attached
to; fit to be appointed or employed in; to be ordered,
commanded, directed, instigated; proper to be en-
joined; (अस्), m. a functionary, official, employé,
servant.

नियुत्सा नि-युत्सा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. युध्
with नि without reduplication), N. of the wife of
Pra-stāva and mother of Vi-bhu.

नि-युद्ध, अम्, n. (fr. rt. युध् with नि), fight-
ing, especially fighting on foot, close fight or combat,
personal struggle.
—नियुद्ध-भू, ऊस्, f. a battle-
field, a place where close fighting has taken place.

नि-योद्धृ, धा, m. a combatant, a wrestler, a
boxer; a cock.

नि-योधक, अस्, m. a fighter, combatant, wrestler,
pugilist.
